mapper.insert: insert into spas_student_pin(student_id, pin_hash, status, fail_count, lock_until, create_time, update_time) values (#{studentId}, #{pinHash}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), 0, null, now(), now()) on conflict (student_id) do update set pin_hash = excluded.pin_hash, status = '0', fail_count = 0, lock_until = null, update_time = now()
mapper.update: update spas_student_pin set fail_count = coalesce(fail_count, 0) + 1, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, update_time = now() where student_id = #{studentId}
update spas_student_pin set status = '1', update_time = now() where student_id = #{studentId}
